authorization: 用户明确授权重设研究目标并自主研究；原S013数据及执行合同内
objective: 寻找扣费后仍有盈利余量的做多机会及可交易风险信息，最终保持原四门并改善32点CAGR_Q10/DD_Q90；此项只检验信息，不证明策略目标
selection_history: 已见截至EX077原开发池证据；EX077整策略未达收益/频率门并停止，本组件不是其退出改装或救援。此前EX071风险方向跨年冲突，EX073风险线索的EX074交易化恶化Q10/Q90；已见选择偏差未被区间校正。
hypothesis: 4日波动在20日中集中可能辨明持仓近期不稳定；原Close的不同时间分布表达，不是新数据。预定观察下行风险正向，继续收益负向。高波动也可能放大反弹是最强反证。
component: std(logCloseReturn last4, population ddof0)/std(logCloseReturn last20, population ddof0); fixed4/20; zero denominator/unavailable explicitly NaN, no fill/epsilon
scope: 唯一actual_signal_continue:原C8880账本T收盘实际quantity>0，且T当前signal_date决策target1。不能以T+1实际成交、未来退出或标签选池。原1635全T轴后mask。
controls: 原EX07122控制，恢复late_recovery并加入20日log-return population std本身(log_sigma20)，共24；保留原simple-return volatility20，不因共线性按结果删项

labels.return_4: Open[T+5]/Open[T+1]-1；相同两端SELL费用抵消；无新BUY费用。原持仓假想延长，不是原真实交易收益
labels.downside_4: max(0,1-min(O/C T+1..T+4,final O T+5)/O[T+1])；不含已无法逃避的Tclose到nextOPEN变化；不是账户最大回撤

method.component_definition: vol_concentration=population std of last4 complete Close logreturns / population std of last20 complete Close logreturns; fixed windows4/20, no fitted thresholds; insufficient/zero20 denominator NaN
method.nuisance_definition: log_sigma20 is std20 OF LOGRETURNS, NOT logarithm of std20; positive available sigma20 only
method.interpretation: Observed O/C price downside is not native account DD or executable profitability. Return not clearly harmed is only a subsequent research clue, never a new acceptance gate. Negative/boundary evidence retained; no sign flip, window search, account escalation or EX077 rescue.

label_contract.return_h: Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]-1; same future/current SELL fee cancels, no new BUY fee
label_contract.downside_h: max(0,1-min(Open/Close T+1..T+h and finalOpen[T+1+h])/Open[T+1]); fixed daily observation downside, not path/account DD
label_contract.negative_gap_next: Initial Tclose-to-nextOpen gap retained for accounting attribution only; both T+1 decision alternatives share it
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

method.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all twenty-four fixed controls, restoring late_recovery and adding log_sigma20, partial residual DF n-rank(design)>=10 required; otherwise unavailable, recording design_rank/residual_df; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
method.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: only actual_signal_continue predeclared scope; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 25 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

method.scope: actual_signal_continue only; actualT quantity>0 AND currentT next-session target1; no flat zero imputation; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

interpretation: 全组/年度/原5相位及成熟年份伪样本外与24控制/训练均值两基准完整报告；区间跨零、不稳定或样本外无新增用途会削弱该固定用途。仅风险预测不能证明扣费退出改善，不能自动进入账户。研究诊断不增经济硬门。
stopping: 本项只有1组件1scope两个h4标签的一次统计。无4/20窗口优化、翻符号、挑年份/相位、退出阈值或账户自动救援。若固定用途无依据则止步，不追加同族账户。
